snp1.3:1.1: Khaggavisāṇasutta. Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ aviheṭhayaṃ aññataram pi tesaṃ na puttam iccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. || ||
snp1.3:2.1: Saṃsaggajātassa bhavati sneho, snehanvayaṃ dukkham idam pahoti, ādīnavaṃ snehajaṃ pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. || ||
snp1.3:3.1: Mitte suhajje anukampamāno hāpeti atthaṃ paṭibaddhacitto, etaṃ bhayaṃ santhave pekkhamāno eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. || ||
snp1.3:4.1: Vaṃso visālo va yathā visatto puttesu dāresu ca yā apekhā,| vaṃsākaḷīro va asajjamāno eko care --pe--. || || Migo
snp1.3:5.1: araññamhi yathā abaddho yenicchakaṃ ghacchati gocarāya, viññū naro seritaṃ pekkhamāno eko care . . . || || Āmantanā
snp1.3:6.1: hoti sahāyamajjhe vāse ṭhāne gamane cārikāya, anabhijjhitaṃ seritaṃ pekkhamāno eko care . . . || || Khiḍḍā ratī hoti sahāyamajjhe
snp1.3:7.1: puttesu ca vipulaṃ hoti pemam, parissayānaṃ sahitā achambhī eko care . . . || || Cātuddiso appatigho
snp1.3:8.1: ca hoti santussamāno itarītarena, parissayānaṃ sahitā achambhī eko care . . . || || Dussaṅgahā pabbajitā
snp1.3:9.1: pi eke atho gahatthā gharam āvasantā, appossukko paraputtesu hutvā eko care . . . || || Oropayitvā
snp1.3:10.1: gihivyañjanāni saṃsīnapatto yathā koviḷāro| chetvāna vīro gihibandhanāni eko care . . . || || Sace labhetha
snp1.3:11.1: nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāri dhīraṃ, abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni careyya ten' attamano satīmā. || ||
snp1.3:12.1: No ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhurihāri dhīraṃ, rājā va raṭṭhaṃ vijitam pahāya eko care . . . || || Addhā pasaṃsāma sahāyasampadaṃ:
snp1.3:13.1: seṭṭhā samā sevitabbā sahāyā, ete aladdhā anavajjabhojī eko care . . . || || Disvā suvaṇṇassa pabhassarāni
snp1.3:14.1: kammāraputtena suniṭṭhitāni saṃghaṭṭamānāni duve bhujasmiṃ eko care . . . || || Evaṃ dutiyena sahā mam'
snp1.3:15.1: assa vācābhilāpo abhisajjanā vā, etaṃ bhayaṃ āyatiṃ pekkhamāno eko care . . . || || Kāmā hi citrā
snp1.3:16.1: madhurā manoramā virūparūpena mathenti cittaṃ, ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā eko care . . . || || ‘Itī ca gaṇḍo
snp1.3:17.1: ca upaddavo ca rogo ca sallañ ca bhayañ ca m' etaṃ,' etaṃ bhayaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā eko care . . . || || Sītañ ca uṇhañ
snp1.3:18.1: ca, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ, vātātāpe ḍaṃsasiriṃsape ca sabbāni p' etāni abhisambhavitvā eko care . . . || || Nāgo va yūthāni vivajjayitvā
snp1.3:19.1: sañjātakhandho padumī ulāro yathābhirantaṃ vihare araññe, eko care . . . || || Aṭṭhāna taṃ saṃgaṇikāratassa,
snp1.3:20.1: yam phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ, -- Ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma || || Diṭṭhīvisūkāni upātivatto
snp1.3:21.1: patto niyāmaṃ paṭiladdhamaggo, ‘uppannañāṇo 'mhi anaññaneyyo' eko care . . . || || Nillolupo nikkuho nippipāso
snp1.3:22.1: nimmakkho niddhantakasāvamoho nirāsayo sabbaloke bhavitvā eko care . . . || || Pāpaṃ
snp1.3:23.1: sahāyaṃ parivajjayetha anatthadassiṃ visame niviṭṭhaṃ, sayaṃ na seve pasutaṃ pamattaṃ, eko care . . . || || Bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ
snp1.3:24.1: bhajetha mittaṃ uḷāraṃ patibhānavantaṃ, aññāya atthāni vineyya kaṃkhaṃ eko care . . . || || Khiḍḍaṃ ratiṃ kāmasukhañ
snp1.3:25.1: ca loke analaṃkaritvā anapekkhamāno vibhūsanaṭṭhānā virato saccavādī eko care . . . || || Puttañ
snp1.3:26.1: ca dāraṃ pitarañ ca mataraṃ dhanāni dhaṇṇāni ca bandhavāni ca hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikāni eko care . . . || || ‘Saṅgo eso,
snp1.3:27.1: parittam ettha sokhyaṃ, app' assādo, dukkham ettha bhiyyo, gaḷo eso' iti {ñatvā} mutīmā eko care . . . || || Sandālayitvā
snp1.3:28.1: saṃyojanāni jālaṃ va bhetvā sālil' ambucārī aggīva daḍḍhaṃ anivattamāno eko care . . . || || Okkhitacakkhū
snp1.3:29.1: na ca pādalolo guttindriyo rakkhitamānasāno amavassuto apariḍayhamāno eko care . . . || || Ohārayitvā
snp1.3:30.1: gihivyañjanāni saṃchinnapatto Yathā pārichatto| kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā eko care . . . || || Rasesu gedhaṃ akaraṃ
snp1.3:31.1: alolo anaññaposī sapadānacārī kule kule appaṭibakkhacitto eko care . . . || || Pahāya pañcāvaraṇāni
snp1.3:32.1: cetaso upakkilese vyapanujja sabbe anissito chetvā sinebadosaṃ eko care . . . || || Vipiṭṭhikatvāna
snp1.3:33.1: sukhaṃ dukhañ ca pubbe va ca somanadomanassaṃ laddhān' upekhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhaṃ eko care . . . || || Āraddhaviriyo
snp1.3:34.1: paramatthapattiyā alīnacitto akusītavutti daḷhanikkamo thāmabalūpapanno eko care . . . || || Paṭisallāṇaṃ
snp1.3:35.1: jhānam ariñcamāno dhammesu niccaṃ anudhammacārī ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesu eko care . . . || || Taṇhakkhayaṃ patthayaṃ
snp1.3:36.1: appamatto anelamūgo sutavā satīmā saṃkhātadhammo niyato padhānavā eko care . . . || || Sīho va saddesu
snp1.3:37.1: asantasanto vāto va jālamhi asajjamāno padumaṃ va toyena alippamāno eko care . . . || || Sīho yathā
snp1.3:38.1: dāṭhabalī pasayha rājā migānaṃ abhibhuyyacārī sevetha pantāni senāsanāni, eko care . . . || || Mettaṃ upekhaṃ karuṇaṃ
snp1.3:39.1: vimuttiṃ āsevamāno muditañ ca kāle sabbena lokena avirujjhamāno eko care . . . || || Rāgañ ca dosañ ca pahāya
snp1.3:40.1: mohaṃ sandālayitvā saṃyojanāni asantasaṃ jīvitasaṃkhayamhi eko care . . . || || Bhajanti sevanti ca
snp1.3:41.1: kāraṇatthā, nikkāraṇā dullabhā dullabhā ajja mittā, āttaṭṭhapaññā asucī manussā, -- eko care khaggavisāṇakappo {ti} || || Khaggavisāyasuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
